newsitem.title: USA: AmEx plans 40 mln share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: AmEx plans 40 mln share repurchase.

text.p: American Express Co said its board of directors aproved a plan to repurchase 40 million common shares over the next two to three years.
American Express said the repurchases will be conducted from time to time in the market as conditions allow.
The company said the plan is primarily designed to allow the company to offset share issuances under employee compensation plans.
Under certain conditions, American Express said it may repurchase additional shares in order to increase economic value for shareholders.
As of September 20, the company had completed two prior repurchase plans totaling 60 million shares.
The company had 482 million common shares outstanding on September 30, 1996.
